t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup. A warm limestone strip at top with a small wordmark, a hairline rule and a large light-weight sans headline. Through the middle, a full-width deep navy band holding a flat 2D single-line schematic of <CONTENT> in pale blue-white hairlines, right-angled pipe runs and simple equipment symbols, no shading. Thin leader lines run from parts of the schematic out to a limestone strip below, where three numbered captions sit in columns: mono number, uppercase sans title, short sans text. Square corners, calm.
signature_idea: One navy schematic band of the whole loop, with long leader lines pulling each option out to its caption below.
strengths: navy band plus limestone sheets is a strong, buildable page rhythm
leader lines link each option to where it sits in the loop
flat hairline schematic is calm and on-brand
three-column caption row is clear and scannable
weaknesses: option 02 caption is duplicated at top right
leader lines are long diagonals that cross each other and read as decorative
schematic is abstract boxes; parts are hard to identify
uppercase option titles feel heavier than the rest of the type
brand_fit_why: Navy band, limestone sheets, pale hairline schematic, light headline and mono numbers fit; duplicated caption and loose diagonals cost precision.
